method: Lines sampled across every scene of the 36-min film (café breakup, car, café with Pooja, park with Vaishu and her husband, lakeside with Bhramara, car/roadside with Pooja, Pratyusha's call and office, Pratyusha's house, Bhramara's flashback, office boss scene, Vaishu and husband, steps/lakeside, rooftop with Virajitha, Prasad's home, final call). For each line 4 frames evenly spaced over the line (runs/gt/qIdAPG8UulE/frames_spk/q_*.jpg, plus dense_929.jpg at 1 fps for 929-959 s) were checked for who is on screen and whose mouth moves, combined with content (names used, who answers whom). Speaker decided before looking at Scribe labels; Scribe label (majority word speaker by time overlap) added afterwards.

label_conventions.speaker: character name from the list; 'OFFSCREEN:<name>' = the speaker is not visible during the line (phone voice, reaction shot held on a listener) but is identified from content/voice context; 'UNKNOWN' = cannot tell. For diarization scoring, strip the OFFSCREEN: prefix.
label_conventions.confidence: 3 = seen speaking and/or unambiguous from content; 2 = likely (wide shot or cut mid-line, content supports); 1 = guess
label_conventions.times: seconds in the episode audio; keyed by time, not by Scribe line id

hard_cases: The 'friend' in the 15:30 car/roadside scene and the café companion at 8:00 are the same actress as cousin Pooja at Prasad's home; all labelled Pooja.
'ప్రతీక్ష'/'ప్రత్యూష' are one character played by one actress across the call, the office 'brother' scene, her house, the boss scene and the final call; labelled Pratyusha.
Vaishu's husband wears a red shirt and glasses at 11:40 and a checked shirt without glasses at 26:00; treated as the same character by content (he calls her ex 'చిన్ను', answers Virajitha's call).
0:09 'అది కాదు, నువ్వేం చెప్పాలనుకుంటున్నావ్' is on Vaishu with her mouth moving and fits her asking; confidence 2.
15:31 'car blast' threat plays entirely on Prasad at the car window, so it is his gag; Pooja answers 'Sadist'.
